document.about: Thermo Scientific M Series centrifuges flyer (2 pages). The cover sets a 12 pt category tag in a red box above the 28 pt title, and the back page closes on a link line.

notes: #130: the flyer writes the space after each word as a glyph with no box. The body column's lines ended in one, the gap to a callout across the gutter was never measured, and each body line ran on into the callout beside it.
#131: the callouts and the body column were then read line by line in turn. Each callout now reads whole, after the body text.

checks.issue: The callout `Wide range of rotors for` was read into the body line `…fit easily into` beside it.
The callout `(up to 21,100 x g` was read into the body line `…ventilated or` beside it, and its first lines were read between the body's.

element.text: Rapid acceleration and deceleration (up to 21,100 x g in ~12 seconds)
